title: Dev version closed loop not avaiable
body:
With the newest dev I get an error that with this dev version closed loop not avaiable, This error occurs only with the latest two versions. The ones before runing well.

Any ideas? Has something changed?

Thx for help.

comments.body:
Copy the engineering file to Documents\AAPS\extra.

And also check the selected AAPS folder in maintenance menu.

Changed folder from AAPS\extra to Documents\AAPS\extra on your request and put the file there.
changed directory in the maintenance menu to documents\AAPS\extra
However AAPS gives the same error
AAPS generates another extra folder within the existing extra folder ???

Found the problem. The directory has to be set to documents\AAPS only. The app adds the \extra folder by itself.
solved, thanks a lot for your help.

> Found the problem. The directory has to be set to documents\AAPS only. The app adds the \extra folder by itself. solved, thanks a lot for your help.
